title: CF Meet Developer Platform control plane v1
description: Section 50 control-plane resources: organizations (Platform Access tenants), human workspace members and invitations, projects (Platform Access applications), environments (Platform Access environments), service accounts (read through Platform Access delegation; never credentials), commercial plan / assignment / billing-account references, immutable activity events and effective entitlements. Identity, credentials and scopes stay Platform Access's. 1.2.0 (Part VI Chapters 10–13): credentials (metadata only; the secret once), credential policy and quota restrictions, scope registry and grants, production-access requests / status / decisions, usage summaries, facts, limits and warnings, support profiles, entitlement overrides and the usage ingestion / reconciliation contract.

Role.description: Part VI workspace role (Section 50 permission matrix).

id.description: The organization id IS the canonical Platform Access tenant id.

classification.description: Platform Access tenant classification (operator-controlled; GET of one organization only).

OrganizationList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

userId.description: Opaque CF Meet account id (human developer); not a Platform Access principal.

MemberList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

token.description: One-time acceptance token, returned ONLY in this response (stored as a digest; never readable again).

InvitationList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

id.description: The project id IS the canonical Platform Access application id.

ProjectList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

scopes.description: Platform Access application scope grants (Platform Access is the authority).

id.description: The canonical Platform Access environment id.

authorityStatus.description: Status reported by Platform Access (GET of one environment).

EnvironmentList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

kind.description: PRODUCTION environments are activated by the production-access workflow (Section 55).

ServiceAccountStatus.description: Platform Access service-account status. The Developer Platform suspends / resumes (ACTIVE ⇄ SUSPENDED); REVOKED is terminal and an operator decision. A non-ACTIVE service account's API credentials do not authenticate.

ServiceAccount.description: A Platform Access service account (machine identity) of one environment, read through the Developer Platform. Platform Access is its only store; API credentials (secrets) are never part of it (Section 54).

id.description: The canonical Platform Access service account id.

name.description: Stable key, unique within the environment.

ServiceAccountList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

name.description: Stable key: 1-63 lowercase letters, digits or '-', starting with a letter or digit; unique within the environment.

CreateServiceAccountRequest.description: Creates a service account in a SANDBOX / TEST environment (PRODUCTION is refused: production-access workflow). No credential is issued (Section 54).

summary.description: Safe change summary: opaque ids, codes and display metadata only — never secrets, credentials, contacts or E2EE material.

ActivityList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

CommercialPlan.description: An immutable commercial plan version. No price exists in Part VI.

CommercialPlanList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

PlanAssignmentList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

BillingAccount.description: Billing-account REFERENCE metadata. Never card, bank, charge or balance data.

subject.description: Internal reads with serviceAccountId / credentialId: the caller's own (never higher) limits and levels; the top-level values stay the environment's.

Entitlements.description: Effective platform entitlements (Section 54 §10.4 precedence: organization plan, explicit operator override, stricter project plan, environment cap, service-account and credential restrictions; the most restrictive value wins and the limiting level is named). Internal reads also carry the versioned snapshot consuming services cache.

Credential.description: Section 54: metadata of a Platform Access API credential. Never a secret or verifier.

secret.description: The raw credential, shown exactly once (never on an idempotent replay).

secretRedacted.description: Present on an idempotent replay instead of the secret.

IssuedCredential.description: Section 54: an issued or rotated credential; the secret is returned once only.

ProductionAccessRequest.description: Section 55 production-access request: SANDBOX_READY → PRODUCTION_REQUESTED → UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED / REJECTED → LIVE / SUSPENDED.

UsageSummary.description: Section 55: environment-scoped daily usage rollups and period totals (billing-neutral quantities).

UsageFactView.description: One immutable usage fact: safe resource reference and public dimensions only (no provider ids, rates or content).

EnvironmentLimits.description: Section 55: effective limits, current usage and remaining allowance where meaningful, and limit warnings.

SupportProfile.description: Section 57 support / incident routing metadata: member references only, no ticket content, emails or phone numbers.

UsageFactSubmission.description: A producer's usage fact (cf_usage_facts wire format); the digest is the canonical payload digest.
